bibl.title: The wool of Naukratis. About the stela Michigan Kelsey Museum 0.2.5803.
bibl.seg: Damien Agut-Labordère, The wool of Naukratis. About the stela Michigan Kelsey Museum 0.2.5803.
British Museum Studies in Ancient Egypt and Sudan 24 (2019) pp. 91-104, figg.
bibl.note: Reedition of a demotic stela that mentions wool and, more specifically, Milesian wool, i.e. the highest-quality Greek wool produced by a special breed of sheep from Asia Minor. - The stela Michigan Kelsey Museum inv. no. 0.2.5803. - Transliteration of the demotic text. - Translation. - Setting the stage: who erected the stela? - How to be a good breeder. - Sheamenopy paid what he had to pay... - ... and took care of the quality of the wool. - Conclusion.
